verdict.rationale: Rollbar documents version tracking that shows which code versions throw exceptions, and deploy tracking that unlocks debugging features when you notify it of releases. Its marketing also says it connects errors and releases and points to the code behind each error. However, the evidence never explicitly shows a per-issue 'first seen in release' field or suspect-commit identification. Missing for 10: explicit first-seen-release per item, documented suspect-commit attribution, commit association details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
